text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I did it! It's all done!
A proper make-up debut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I managed to get out of the gate, and I didn't bump into the inner rail, and see? I'm totally fine and full of energy...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-Do... I have... energy...?
Hanyanyanyanyaa~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLAM...!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, what's wrong!?
Doto! Dotoooooo!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —To be continued!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wee-woo, wee-woo)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fwehhh, I'm sorry~.
Sorry for causing such a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Goodness~, I was so startled when you called.
I'm just glad it wasn't anything serious."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exam results showed nothing serious.
However—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: It isn't overwork or anemia. It seems she didn't collapse purely from simple exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Then why
did she collapse?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as for the possible explanations...
Normally it would be impossible, but—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps her body hasn't entered
its 'prime bloom' period just yet."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"'Growth spurt'...
If I remember correctly, that means..."

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, I'll be the one to give a detailed
explanation regarding the 'growth phase.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A female doctor stepped in from the side and took over.

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
At a certain point during adolescence,
an Umamusume's body begins to grow rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text: Entering that period of growth is what we call "reaching maturity."

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The Awakening is what you'd call an athletic awakening.
From there, her abilities will reach their peak,
and eventually begin a gradual decline...

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The start of the Awakening is a crucial point,
but the tricky part is that
it cannot be judged objectively.

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text: The only criterion is... 'whether the person themselves can vaguely sense it or not,' right?

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
For example, feeling strangely light on your feet. Having an enormous appetite.
Being able to do things you never could before...

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text: If you can feel the changes that come with such growth, there is a high chance she has entered her peak period.

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
One of the systems used to confirm they've hit their stride
is the "Debut Selection Race."

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text: "Only after demonstrating her ability and becoming confident that she was in a period of growth did she sign a contract with a Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A selection race to confirm her Awakening...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I totally felt like I ran in that race, though~
I could've sworn I did~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Did it... show, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried looking back
on how I first met Meisho Doto, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawawa, I'm such a klutz~!
So without even proving I can race,
my Make Debut is gonnaaa~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry,
I'm so sorry, I'm sorryyyy~~~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, look what I've done~!
Even if I can make my debut like this, there's no way things will go well... Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Doto-san...
Don't worry about it so much~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this...
If it's come to this—!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, don't be hasty!
Please don't talk about quitting!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Little by little...
I'll do my best, bit by biiiit~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Since she hasn't reached her Awakening yet, even if she
can't make a big splash in major races, as long as she
enters a lot of smaller races...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It might not work, it might be impossible, but I'll do my best bit by bit, and then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I want to be recognized
as your trainee, Trainer~! Would that be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only thing I had in spades was stubbornness. So I chose to endure
for now—and wait for my body to awaken.

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well, there might be a make-or-break, all-in-one
solution out there, though.

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text: ――Alrighty, disguise off☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap!)

text_block_list.name: Female Doctor
text_block_list.text: Wanna give it a shot? Right in the gut?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside the suspicious person, I decided to steadily enter her into races.
As her skills improve and she gains more fans, it will surely boost her confidence.
